statBlock.specialAbilities:
SRD type: Sphinx

Sphinxes are enigmatic creatures with great, feathery wings and leonine bodies. All sphinxes are territorial, but the more intelligent ones can differentiate between deliberate intrusion and temporary or inadvertent trespass.

A typical sphinx is about 10 feet long and weighs about 800 pounds.

Sphinxes speak Sphinx, Common, and Draconic.

Combat

Most sphinxes fight on the ground, using their wings to help them pounce much as lions do. If outnumbered by earthbound creatures, a sphinx takes wing and attacks on the fly.

Pounce (Ex)

If a sphinx charges a foe, it can make a full attack, including two rake attacks.

Rake (Ex)

A sphinx that pounces onto a creature can make two rake attacks with its hind legs. Each sphinx’s description provides its attack bonus and damage.

Special Attacks: Pounce, rake 2d4+3, roar, spells

Special Qualities: Darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision

Imported from the d20 SRD; verify attacks and skills in-game. Full rules at d20srd.org.

system.biography:
These sphinxes are always male. Androsphinxes are clever and generally good-natured, but they can be savage opponents.

Combat

In battle, an androsphinx rips apart enemies with its razor-sharp claws. It relies on its natural weapons in a fight, employing its spells for defense or healing.

Rake (Ex)

Attack bonus +18 melee, damage 2d4+3.

Roar (Su)

Three times per day an androsphinx can loose a mighty roar. The first time it does this, all creatures within 500 feet must succeed on a DC 19 Will save or be affected as though by a fear spell for 2d6 rounds.

If the sphinx roars a second time during the same encounter, all creatures within 250 feet must succeed on a DC 19 Fortitude save or be paralyzed for 1d4 rounds, and all those within 90 feet are deafened for 2d6 rounds (no save). If it roars a third time during the same encounter, all those within 250 feet must succeed on a DC 19 Fortitude save or take 2d4 points of Strength damage for 2d4 rounds. In addition, any Medium or smaller creature within 90 feet must succeed on a DC 19 Fortitude save or be thrown to the ground and take 2d8 points of damage. The force of this roar is so great that it deals 50 points of damage to any stone or crystalline object within 90 feet. Magic items and held or carried items can avoid damage with a DC 19 Reflex save. Other androsphinxes are immune to these effects. The save DCs are Charisma-based.

Spells

An androsphinx casts divine spells as a 6th-level cleric from the cleric spell list and from the Good, Healing, and Protection domains.

Typical Cleric Spells Prepared (5/5/5/4; save DC 13 + spell level)

0—cure minor wounds, detect magic, guidance, light, resistance; 1st—divine favor, protection from evil*, shield of faith, remove fear, summon monster I; 2nd—bull’s strength, remove paralysis, resist energy, shield other*, summon monster II; 3rd—cure serious wounds*, daylight, invisibility purge, searing light.

*Domain spell. Domains: Good and Healing.

system.benefit: You get a +2 bonus on all Listen checks and Spot checks.

system.description: You can strike two adjacent foes with a single swing.
system.benefit: As a standard action, you can make a single attack at your full base attack bonus against a foe within reach. If you hit, you deal damage normally and can make an additional attack (using your full base attack bonus) against a foe that is adjacent to the first and also within reach. You can only make one additional attack per round with this feat. You cannot use this feat if you are wearing heavy armor.
system.special: A fighter may select Cleave as one of his fighter bonus feats.

system.description: You can strike many adjacent foes with a single swing.
system.prerequisites: Cleave, Power Attack, Str 13, base attack bonus +4
system.benefit: As a standard action, you can make a single attack at your full base attack bonus against a foe within reach. If you hit, you deal damage normally and can make an additional attack (using your full base attack bonus) against a foe that is adjacent to the first and also within reach. If you hit that foe, you can continue to make attacks against other adjacent foes so long as you keep hitting. You cannot attack an individual foe more than once per round with this feat. You cannot use this feat if you are wearing heavy armor.
system.special: A fighter may select Great Cleave as one of his fighter bonus feats.

system.description: Use a standard action at any point while flying (including during a dive).
system.benefit: When flying, the creature can take a move action (including a dive) and another standard action at any point during the move. The creature cannot take a second move action during a round when it makes a flyby attack.
system.special: Normal: Without this feat, the creature takes a standard action either before or after its move.

system.description: You can make exceptionally powerful melee attacks.
system.benefit: On your action, before making attack rolls for a round, you may choose to subtract a number from all melee attack rolls and add the same number to all melee damage rolls. This number may not exceed your base attack bonus. The penalty on attacks and bonus on damage apply until your next turn.

system.description: You can follow the trails of creatures and characters across most types of terrain.
system.benefit: To find tracks or to follow them for 1 hour requires a Survival check. You must make another Survival check every hour to continue following the tracks. The DC depends on the surface and the prevailing conditions.
system.special: A ranger automatically gains Track as a bonus feat at 1st level. He need not select it.

system.description: You can use this skill to frighten opponents or to get them to act in a way that benefits you.
Ancient mysteries, magic traditions, arcane symbols, cryptic phrases, constructs, dragons, magical beasts. Like other Knowledge skills, each Knowledge field is a separate skill with its own ranks.
Your Listen check is either made against a DC that reflects how quiet the noise is that you might hear, or it is opposed by the target's Move Silently check.
Your Spot check is either made against a DC that reflects how obvious the object is, or it is opposed by the target's Hide check.
You are skilled at surviving in the wild and at following tracks.

What it does (SRD): If the creature charges, it can still make a full attack at the end of the charge (including rake attacks if listed).

ThirdEra: This is a full-attack pattern, not a numeric modifier here. Leave Mechanical effects and Capability grants empty unless you add a custom row. Resolve charge distance and attacks using the NPC sheet and combat tracker as usual.

What it does (SRD): When the creature grapples or sometimes when it pounces, it can make extra natural attacks (usually two claw rakes) at the listed attack bonus against a grappled or appropriate target.

ThirdEra: Add rake attacks to the NPC’s Natural attacks list on the sheet (or note them in Description) so attack bonuses match the stat block. This template keeps Mechanical effects and Capability grants empty.

Roar (Su): Three times per day an androsphinx can emit a magical roar with differing effects (fight, weaken, fear) per the SRD.

Spells: Androsphinx casts divine spells as a cleric from cleric spell lists and domains; caster level as listed in its statistics.
